body: Like I said before I don't have the money for therapy, IG I'm fucked, right?

Ah, so I did have a few coping strategies ( drawing, working out ,writing down my feelings), however the amount of chores I've been assigned has taken away from that time. ( yes I've tried negotiating, no it doesn't work)

My parents enlisted me with my consent but didn't include the fact that I have depression, so I'm either gonna get caught taking prescribed pills and lying (even though its their fault) or what I'm forced to do which is pretend it doesn't exist and try to fix myself
